tasks.label: Find a size exchange
tasks.answer: Milestones completed: 1) help_opened - Yes, accessed Customer Service help page. 2) returns_found - Yes, found Returns, Refunds, Replacement section with relevant links. 3) exchange_rules_read - Yes, read about the exchange policy: customers can exchange items for different sizes/colors subject to availability within 10 days of delivery, items must be in original condition with tags/packaging. 4) request_page_reached - No, blocked by sign-in wall. The Returns Centre redirected to a login page requiring email/mobile number entry. Per task instructions, the agent stopped on the sign-in page and did not proceed with fake credentials. No payment details or final confirmation buttons were reached.
tasks.blocker_detail: After successfully navigating through all milestones up to exchange_rules_read (opened help, found returns/exchange policy, and read the exchange rules including the 10-day free exchange policy for different sizes), the Returns Centre page redirected to a sign-in/login wall. Amazon.in requires authentication to access the exchange request form, which blocked progression to the request_page_reached milestone.
